articles.summary: Illuminant Surgical will be presenting at the 2025 MDIC MedXR Summit, November 4–6 in Hyattsville, Maryland. Our poster, “Simplifying Cybersecurity for Start-Ups: A Practical Framework for eSTAR-Ready Documentation” will cover our in-house framework harmonizing AAMI TIR57, SW96, ISO 14971, and FDA guidance.
